title: LRASGen: LLM-based RESTful API Specification Generation
abstract: arXiv:2504.16833v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: REpresentation State Transfer (REST) is an architectural style for designing web applications that enable scalable, stateless communication between clients and servers via common HTTP techniques. Web APIs that employ the REST style are known as RESTful (or REST) APIs. When using or testing a RESTful API, developers may need to employ its specification, which is often defined by open-source standards such as the OpenAPI Specification (OAS). However, it can be very time-consuming and error-prone to write and update these specifications, which may negatively impact the use of RESTful APIs, especially when the software requirements change. Many tools and methods have been proposed to solve this problem, such as Respector and Swagger Core. OAS generation can be regarded as a common text-generation task that creates a formal description of API endpoints derived from the source code. A potential solution for this may involve using Large Lan

translated_title: LRASGen：基于大型语言模型的RESTful API规范生成
translated_abstract: 摘要：arXiv:2504.16833v2 公告类型：替换 摘要：表述性状态转移（REST）是一种用于设计Web应用程序的架构风格，它通过常见的HTTP技术实现客户端和服务器之间的可扩展、无状态通信。采用REST风格的Web API被称为RESTful（或REST）API。在使用或测试RESTful API时，开发者可能需要使用其规范，该规范通常由开源标准（如OpenAPI规范，简称OAS）定义。然而，编写和更新这些规范可能非常耗时且容易出错，这可能会对RESTful API的使用产生负面影响，尤其是在软件需求发生变化时。许多工具和方法已被提出以解决此问题，例如Respector和Swagger Core。OAS生成可以被视为一种常见的文本生成任务，它从源代码中创建API端点的正式描述。一个潜在的解决方案可能涉及使用大型语言模型。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于大型语言模型的方法，用于自动生成RESTful API的OpenAPI规范，旨在减少手动编写和更新规范的耗时与错误，提高API使用的效率。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an LLM-based approach to automatically generate OpenAPI specifications for RESTful APIs, aiming to reduce the time-consuming and error-prone manual specification writing and updating, thereby improving API usability.
